default.description: The Radio Group component appears as a vertical list of options, each accompanied by a circular radio button. The layout is clean and organized, with each option clearly separated, allowing for easy selection. The overall design is simple and functional, focusing on usability and clarity.

variants.difference: In this variant, the Radio Group component is expanded to accommodate a vertical list of radio buttons, each aligned with corresponding text options. The layout is more spacious, with a clear separation between each option, enhancing visibility and selection ease. The design maintains a clean and organized appearance, focusing on functionality and user interaction.
